## Change and decision

Linked issue or editorial reason:

Affected release or draft commit:

Change in meaning, compatibility impact, alternatives, and unresolved objections:

## Evidence

- [ ] Rule IDs and normative wording agree, or this is editorial only.
- [ ] Every new rule has a test or a reason in `spec/untested.yaml`.
- [ ] Catalog source, generated JSON, and schemas agree with the wording.
- [ ] Declarations and cited evidence reflect any changed meaning.
- [ ] Changed examples and their displayed output were rerun.
- [ ] Changelog and version updated when required.
- [ ] `make check` passes without provider credentials.
- [ ] Commits carry DCO sign-off.
